subject: Nice to meet at ICLR
text:
Hi [NAME],

Great to meet at ICLR - hope you enjoyed the rest of the conference & safe
travels back to France!

Was very interesting to hear about your current focus on VLMs - an area
we're very excited to support fine-tuning for our Robotics / Physical AI
partners.

Was also interesting to hear your observation about ScaleAI operating as a
black box service - Encord has taken a different approach as a
software-first platform, enabling teams to be more hands on and in control
of the data - helping teams to iterate / re-train models, faster.

Sounded like annotating / visualising radar was also a key area of interest
- let me know if you or your team would be interested in taking a look at
we've been building in partnership with other AV teams (Woven, Wayve, Oxa
etc.)
